# Code of conduct

We want this issue tracker to be a friendly, useful place for everyone.

- Be respectful and constructive. Assume good intent.
- Stay on topic: bugs, feature requests and questions about OnCallAlert.
- No harassment, insults, discrimination, spam or advertising.
- Do not post other people's private information.

Maintainers may edit, hide or lock comments and issues, and may block users who break these rules.

To report a problem with someone's behaviour, email contact@oncallalert.dev.

This code of conduct is adapted from the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2.1/code_of_conduct/).
